notes: Book (STA 2e Core p.288): in any turn a combatant attempts one major action and one minor action (actionsPerTurn). Designer decision (Oct 2026, replacing the earlier 2 AP rule): Combat Type 1 uses this. Each action's type is 'major', 'minor' or 'free'.

Book (p.288, p.260): a second major action for 2 Momentum (the task is +1 Difficulty; Swift Action), and an Extra Minor Action for 1 Momentum (once per turn: each minor action may only be performed once per turn). Nobody attempts more than two major actions in a round; Direct gives an ally a second one with no +1 but never a third. NPCs pay with Threat (hook: the AI doesn't buy them yet).

Book (p.288): the Movement minor action (Move) cannot be taken in the same turn as the Movement major action (Sprint), nor while any enemy is within Reach. The book gives no disengage rule and none is added: Sprint is still allowed next to an enemy.
Designer decision (Oct 2026), following the book (STA 2e Quickstart p. 22): there is no Take Cover action. A unit next to a cover object is in cover automatically.

panel: the actions shown in the Actions panel. selfRing: the acting character's own actions around them; only the ones possible right now are shown (contextual actions: First Aid, Direct, Guard, challenge objects in reach, Extra Minor, Second Major).

Designer decision (Oct 2026): Attack and Aim are not in the panel. Clicking an enemy shows buttons around it: Stun and Deadly (fire at once), Aim and Info. Clicking a party member shows Assist (and Switch, to hand them the turn).

Designer decision (Oct 2026): the acting character's own ring also offers Attack as one button per firing mode the current weapon allows (its injuryModes: Stun and/or Deadly), showing the weapon's Severity and, for Deadly, +1 Threat. Picking one chooses the mode for the next attack only; the player then picks the target and fires from the task panel (Fire). The Threat is charged when the attack resolves, never on picking the mode.

tasks: the predefined combat tasks (Book p.288: Guard, First Aid, Direct). Attribute, department and Difficulty are book rules; 'focuses' are VIDEOGAME ADAPTATION (designer-authored lists of the focus names that apply, matched exactly, Oct 2026).

communication (Direct): Book p.288 'select one ally who can hear you'. Prototype hook: an ally hears the commander when within audibleRangeTiles (implementation detail, placeholder value; flag for designer), or when both carry a working communicator (an item tagged 'communication'). A scene can block communicators (combat state comms.remoteBlocked: jamming, comms disabled, isolation).

adaptationMomentumSpends: VIDEOGAME ADAPTATION, off by default (Oct 2026). The earlier designer spends (1 Momentum: reroll one die, cancel 1 Threat) are not STA 2E RAW; true turns them back on. Buy d20s (Book p.259) is always available.

guard.note: Book (p.288): Insight + Security, Difficulty 0; success raises the Difficulty of attacks against you by 1 until the start of your next turn. Guarding an ally within Reach instead: +1 Difficulty, lasting until the start of the ally's next turn. Book p.254: a Difficulty 0 task needs no roll unless the gamemaster allows one to generate Momentum; Prototype: Guard always rolls through the shared task resolver (it always passes at Difficulty 0, and every success is Momentum).

firstAidRevive.note: Book (p.288, p.292): revive a Defeated character within Reach, Daring + Medicine, Difficulty 2; success: no longer Defeated, though they may still have an Injury.

firstAidTreat.note: Book (p.288, p.292): tend to an Injury on another character within Reach, Daring + Medicine, Difficulty = the Injury's severity; success: the Injury is treated (no penalty, but still an Injury needing proper medical treatment).

directAssist.note: Book (p.288): the commander Assists the directed ally's action with Control + Command.

actions.name: Move
actions.description: Once per turn: walk up to your full movement. Not in a turn you Sprint, and not while an enemy is within Reach. End next to a cover object to be in cover.

actions.name: Aim
actions.description: Reroll one die on your next attack this turn; up to two with an Accurate weapon.

actions.name: Interact
actions.description: Use an object in reach. Each approach costs what it is authored to cost (a simple interaction is a minor action, a task a major action).

actions.name: Sprint
actions.description: Once per turn, not in a turn you Move: run up to half your movement (rounded up), no roll. End next to a cover object to be in cover.
notes: Book (STA 2e Core p.288): Sprint is a major action (move two zones); not in the same turn as the Movement minor action.
Designer decision (Oct 2026): no roll, ceil(movement / 2) tiles; everyone (party and Klingons) and every AI can use it. Not an attack, so it doesn't end the Ambush chance.

actions.name: Assist
actions.description: Pick an ally who still has a turn this round. Their next task this round (an attack, Guard, First Aid or an object task) adds your 1d20; its successes count if they score at least one.

actions.name: Guard
actions.description: Insight + Security, Difficulty 0: attacks against you are +1 Difficulty until the start of your next turn. Guard an ally within Reach instead at Difficulty 1 (until the start of their next turn).

actions.name: First Aid
actions.description: Daring + Medicine on an ally within Reach: revive a Defeated ally (Difficulty 2; the Injury stays), or treat one Injury (Difficulty = its severity).

actions.name: Direct
actions.description: Only the character in authority. Spend 1 Momentum: an ally who can hear you (in earshot or by communicator) takes one action now, and you assist it with Control + Command. Never a third major action for them this round.

actions.name: Extra Minor
actions.description: Spend 1 Momentum: one more minor action this turn (once per turn; a minor action you already took can't be repeated).

actions.name: Second Major
actions.description: After your major action, spend 2 Momentum for a second one this turn. Its task is +1 Difficulty. Nobody takes more than two major actions in a round.

actions.name: Ambush
actions.description: Once, until anyone attacks: the party member with the best Control + Security rolls at Difficulty 1 against a Klingon they could shoot (Camouflage or Ambush Tactics rerolls a failed die). Success: an automatic hit (an Injury from their weapon on Stun). Failure: a new round starts and the Klingons act first for the rest of the fight.
notes: Book (Captain's Log p. 74): Control is used for remaining stealthy. Book (p. 205): an ambusher 'may score an automatic hit'.

VIDEOGAME ADAPTATION (designer decision, Oct 2026): the whole Ambush action. Best Control + Security in the party rolls; success = an automatic hit on a chosen Klingon (the ambusher's first weapon in range, on Stun when it has a Stun setting; Book p.291 Injury rules apply: the target may Avoid Injury with Stress like any full character), failure = the Klingons act first this fight.
VIDEOGAME ADAPTATION: the free reroll of one failed die with Camouflage or Ambush Tactics. It is not Aim and not a book focus effect.
Designer decision (Oct 2026): only a Klingon the ambusher could shoot right now (in one of their weapons' range, with a clear line of fire).

Designer decision (Oct 2026): the chance lasts until anyone attacks (either side); Klingon turns spent moving don't spot the party, so it can close in over several rounds. Offered on party turns only.
Implementation detail (flag for designer): a failed ambush ends the party's current round at once (members yet to act lose that turn) and starts a new round with the Klingons first.
